name: Cadence
thesis: A calm, lavender-tinted email-marketing back-office in the master-detail idiom: a fixed campaign list drives a per-campaign report. Violet (#7C3AED) leads, sky (#38BDF8) supports; white cards on a #FBFAFF page with hairline borders keep it airy and operator-friendly rather than flashy.
layout: Two-pane master-detail shell: a fixed 300px left rail (brand + search + scrollable campaign list) beside a scrolling detail column — a sticky topbar, a 4-up KPI row, a 1.5fr/1fr row (opens-over-time chart + ranked links), and a full-width deliverability card. Comfortable, airy density; white cards on a lavender page.

sections.name: Sidebar + brand
sections.what: Fixed rail with a gradient sky→violet logo mark, wordmark, search box, and the campaign master list.
sections.restyle: Sidebar rail on #FFFFFF; gradient logo mark; pill search input.

sections.name: Campaign list
sections.what: Six selectable campaign rows — status dot, meta line, and inline open/click % on the selected row.
sections.restyle: Selectable rows with an inset-violet left rail + tinted bg on the active id; status dot is a Badge colored by {sent/scheduled/draft}.

sections.name: Detail topbar
sections.what: Sticky header for the selected campaign — title, green Sent pill, recipient meta.
sections.restyle: Slim sticky Navbar; Badge for send status.

sections.name: KPI row
sections.what: Open rate, click rate, revenue, unsubs — four stat tiles.
sections.restyle: Restyled Card KPI tiles, uppercase micro-label + 28px colored value.

sections.name: Opens since send
sections.what: Cumulative opens across the first 48h after send.
sections.restyle: EChart area — violet line with a top-down gradient fill over an hours-since-send axis, inside a Card.

sections.name: Top clicked links
sections.what: Four destination URLs ranked by click share with proportional bars.
sections.restyle: Progress bars (sky #38BDF8 fill on #F0EEF7 track), mono URLs, inside a Card.

sections.name: Deliverability
sections.what: Delivered / bounced / spam / failed mini-tiles on a lavender fill.
sections.restyle: A Card of four color-coded mini Cards.

palette.restyle: The 300px master rail — brand header, search, campaign list.
The selectable campaign list; active row gets a tinted bg + inset-violet left rail.
KPI tiles, the chart/links panels, and the deliverability mini-tiles.
The opens-since-send area chart (violet gradient areaStyle).
The ranked top-clicked-links bars (sky fill on lavender track).
Send-status pills + the campaign status dots (sent/scheduled/draft color map).
The gradient sky→violet Cadence logo mark.

contentArchetype: An email-marketing operator's per-campaign report — a fixed list of sends on the left, and the selected campaign's opens/clicks/revenue/deliverability on the right. Swap in your own campaigns and metrics.
remix: The master-detail shell (300px selectable list + sticky-topbar detail) generalizes to any 'list drives a report' admin — support tickets, orders, subscribers. Keep the airy lavender-on-white and the single hero chart; make the accent your brand color and the list rows your entities.
